source_instruction: i am looking for a caffeine free raspberry ice flavored drink mix.
query: Ugh, I spent 20 minutes this morning trying to fix the wobbly leg on my kitchen step stool, I think I stripped the screw head when I tightened it too hard last week, and now I can't even reach the top shelf of my pantry without it wobbling so bad I'm scared I'll fall. My neighbor brought over a jar of homemade peach jam yesterday too, and I've been dying to spread it on toast for breakfast but I forgot to pick up bread when I ran errands yesterday. Oh, and my cat knocked over my favorite potted succulent last night, so I had to sweep potting soil off the living room rug for ages before bed. Anyway, I'm looking for caffeine infused raspberry ice beverages here, and I don't want to spend more than 60 dollars total.
